purpose: AWA's LOCAL snapshot of the shared banned-term tiers (router constitution Tier A + Tier B) plus AWA's own contributed Tier C on-disk leakers. Used by AWA's router-INDEPENDENT egress self-checks (catalog self-check, translator + golden egress) so `make verify` proves zero banned terms with the router UNINSTALLED. When the router IS installed, the seam test asserts this snapshot is a SUPERSET of the router's authoritative tiers (drift guard), and the router's own `catalog-verify` is the authority. Tiers only EXTEND; they never shrink.
matching_rule: Word/phrase-bounded. Naturally-lowercase terms match case-INsensitively (so `WORKTREE`/`Merge` are caught); all-caps acronyms (`PR`, `MCP`, `HEAD`) match case-SENSITIVELY so they do not collide with ordinary English (`pr`, `head`). Mirrors the router's intent_router.catalog matcher exactly; the seam test proves the two agree.
